# Chapter 03 · Session 14 — Ledger — Wrap-Up

## Narrative Recap

The crew spent the morning at the [[Harbour Festival Grounds]], where the stalls were going up and [[Corvin Tash]] was hauling lamp oil. He admitted the guild had been paid to leave the [[Dock Row]] lamp unlit.

By afternoon they had the ledger page from [[Odalys Venn]]'s safe. It listed a payment to the harbourmaster's office, and [[Harl Brannock]] arrived before they could read it twice.

Harl took the page in the name of the port. The crew let him, then argued about it all evening at [[The Salt Inn]].

### What Carries Forward

#### Unresolved Threads

- **Ledger page:** [[Odalys Venn]] wants the ledger page taken from her safe returned, and [[Harl Brannock]] now holds it.
- **Who paid the guild:** [[Odalys Venn]] swears she never paid to have the Dock Row lamp left unlit, so someone else did.
- ~~**The ferry toll:** the crew traced the missing toll to the harbourmaster's office.~~
- **Unsigned notes:** someone keeps slipping the crew notes with no name on them.

#### Resolved Threads

- The question of who opened the chandler's safe: carried on a live list.

#### Player-Stated Intentions

- **Festival schedule:** the crew will ask for the Harbour Festival schedule to see when the guild lights the lamps.
- **Guildhall visit:** Mirren wants to follow [[Corvin Tash]] to the Lamplighters Guild hall.

#### Pending Consequences

- **The page is gone:** [[Harl Brannock]] will log the ledger page as port evidence, so the crew cannot use it openly.
- **Corvin's wound:** [[Corvin Tash]] was cut in the scuffle and will blame the crew to his guild.

#### NPCs Needing Follow-Up

- **[[Odalys Venn]]:** decide whether she hides the crew or turns them in.
- **[[Harl Brannock]]:** decide what he does with the ledger page tonight.
- **[[Corvin Tash]]:** decide what the guild learns of the scuffle.
